# Try Convi

> Real conversational Spanish, Swedish and German — the phrases people actually
> say in Spain, Sweden and Germany, with what they will say back. Every page is
> free to read, with no account and no paywall.

Each scenario page opens with a short answer — the single most useful line for
that situation — followed by the full exchanges: what they ask, what you say,
and their likely reply. Phrases are written for the country named, not for a
generic textbook register.

## Spanish (Spain)

- [All Spanish scenarios](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios): every Spanish category in one list.
- [How to get around in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/getting-around): Spanish phrases for getting around (taxi + metro).
- [How to use slang in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/slang): Spanish phrases for slang.
- [How to order a beer in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/beer-food): Spanish phrases for ordering a beer/food like a local.
- [How to start a conversation in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/starting-convo): Spanish phrases for starting a convo/basic survival.
- [How to order at a restaurant in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/restaurant): Spanish phrases for at a restaurant.
- [How to check into a hotel in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/hotel): Spanish phrases for checking in (hotel/hostel/airbnb).
- [How to shop and haggle in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/shopping): Spanish phrases for shopping, markets & haggling.
- [How to shut down a creep in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/for-the-girls): Spanish phrases for for the girls.
- [How to swear in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/cuss-words): Spanish phrases for cuss words & "don't get punched" warnings.
- [How to call someone attractive in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/flirting): Spanish phrases for calling someone attractive.
- [How to ask for medicine in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/resacon): Spanish phrases for sickness & feeling hungover.
- [How to get help in an emergency in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/emergencies): Spanish phrases for robbed & emergencies.
- [How to get into a club in Spain](https://tryconvi.com/scenarios/nightlife): Spanish phrases for nightlife — into the club & making friends.
- [Practise Spanish](https://tryconvi.com/practice): free drills over the same material.

- [How to swear in Germany](https://tryconvi.com/de/scenarios/de-cuss-words): German phrases for cuss words & "don't get punched" warnings (germany).

## Notes

- Content is human-written per country, not machine-translated between editions.
- Spanish is Spain Spanish (vosotros, caña, vale), not Latin American.
- Swedish is Stockholm-weighted; German covers Germany-wide plus a Bavarian set.
